payload.title: Remove the disclaimer paragraph from the published article 'Federal AI Safety Office confirms AI is safe after asking AI'
payload.description:
Edit the published article so it no longer opens with (or carries) the disclaimer paragraph ('Satire: this article is fiction. The people, agency and quotations in it are invented.'). BLOCKED until the furniture label (HUM-0bd4aa) is live on the page: the piece must never be published without a label. Do not edit the article before then.

How: a new Story version saved with the papyrus CLI signed in to this site, then a person approves and publishes it (decision 13). Access today (2026-11-15): 'papyrus whoami' shows a signed-in session for https://newsroom.thehallucinator.ai (the CLI is pinned at 5.105.0 and the backend is newer, which is the allowed direction). I have not tried an edit. Follow the papyrus CLI guide (papyrus guide) for the exact commands; never use the AWS CLI for Papyrus operations.
